title: Do not quote ${plugin} in GF_INSTALL_PLUGINS loop
answers: Why is ${plugin} unquoted in the grafana cli plugins install call?
GF_INSTALL_PLUGINS single-plugin install fails or installs wrong thing when quoted
How does run.sh pass a plugin spec to grafana cli plugins install?
body:
Symptom: quoting `${plugin}` in the plugin-install command breaks installs (reviewer explicitly asked to keep it unquoted and the author reverted the quoting).
Root cause: packaging/docker/run.sh's non-semicolon plugin branch calls `grafana cli --pluginsDir "${GF_PATHS_PLUGINS}" plugins install ${plugin}`; the grafana cli command parses plugin id/version as separate positional args (`args[n]`), relying on shell word-splitting of the unquoted variable.
Fix pattern: leave `${plugin}` unquoted in that specific call even though it looks like a quoting bug; only the URL/folder vars in the semicolon branch should be quoted.
Constraints: applies only to this grafana-cli plugin-install invocation; a proper fix would change the grafana cli to accept a single combined arg, but that is an unmade follow-up.

Quoting ${plugin} breaks installs even though it appears to be a quoting bug. The URL and folder variables in the semicolon branch should remain quoted, but only the grafana cli plugin-install call must keep ${plugin} unquoted.
